shops.name: Tamsin Pennywhistle's Peddler Cart
shops.keeper: Tamsin (older) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Don't tell me, let me guess. Rope, rations and a tinderbox? Thought so!
quirks: Keeps a ledger of every traveller who has ever passed through.
Keeps a stool by the counter just for folk who need a sit and a natter.
shops.rumour: [true] Hew the cooper is selling off family heirlooms in a hurry. Debts, or something worse.

shops.name: Fenwick Pennywhistle's Peddler Cart
shops.keeper: Fenwick (older) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Ooh, new faces! You look like folk who need rope. Everyone needs rope.
quirks: Remembers what every customer bought last time, and asks how it went.
shops.rumour: [partly true] Barrel staves keep going missing from the cooper's yard. Somebody's building a raft, or a lot of small boxes.

shops.name: Wilmot Pennywhistle's General Goods
shops.keeper: Wilmot (middle-aged) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Come in, come in! Mind the cat. Now, what's the news from the road?
quirks: Wears their mint curls pinned up with a pencil and loses the pencil hourly.
Tucks a sprig of lavender behind each customer's ear, whether they like it or not.
shops.rumour: [partly true] Every sheep at Ravenhay was shorn overnight. The wool's gone, and so is whoever sheared them.

shops.name: The Wandering Wyrm
shops.keeper: Ulthra (young) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Mud on the floor? Pah! Mud's good luck in a Hearthscale house. Come in, come in!
quirks: Is quietly terrified of mice and pays a copper for every one caught.
shops.rumour: [false] The Emberforge family threw a feast here and paid with a bag of pearls. Where does a shopkeeper get pearls?

shops.name: Pennywhistle's Everything Shop
shops.keeper: Rufus (old) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Hello, hello! Don't mind the clutter, it's all for sale. Well, most of it.
quirks: Forecasts the weather with a creaky knee and is right more often than the almanac.
shops.rumour: [partly true] Wat the reeve won the pig at the fair and has been treating it like a prince. Says it talks.

shops.name: The Snoring Ox
shops.keeper: Ilthara (middle-aged) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: You've got a story on you, I can tell. Sit down, have a pie, and spill it.
quirks: Keeps a jar of pickled eggs on the bar that nobody has ever been brave enough to try.
shops.rumour: [partly true] The bridge toll went up again. The toll-keeper says it's on orders, but nobody's seen the orders.

shops.name: Pennywhistle & Kin Trading Post
shops.keeper: Clover (older) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Wipe your boots, dears. Now then, what can a Pennywhistle do for you?
quirks: Offers a discount to anyone who can name all the Pennywhistle cousins. Nobody can.
shops.rumour: [false] Someone's stealing washing off the lines. Only left socks, and only on washdays.

shops.name: Morrin Emberforge's Smithy
shops.keeper: Morrin (middle-aged) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Ask the price, I'll tell you. Haggle, and I'll double it.
quirks: Won't set jewels in a hilt: "Jewels are for folk who can't fight."
shops.rumour: [partly true] The lord's steward has been measuring fields with a rope and a strange brass gauge. Nobody asked him to.

shops.name: The Smoking Goose
shops.keeper: Medrash (old) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Rooms upstairs, food at the bar, gossip anywhere you like. What'll it be, friends?
quirks: Grows herbs in the window boxes and drops a sprig of something into every bowl.
shops.rumour: [true] My ale's been going sour overnight. Only the barrels against the east wall of the cellar.

shops.name: Pennywhistle's Nooks & Crannies
shops.keeper: Larkin (middle-aged) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Back again? Oh, no, that was the other lot. You all look alike under the mud.
quirks: Can't resist reading a customer's shopping list aloud to the whole shop.
Owns a parrot that repeats the last bit of gossip it heard, at the worst moment.
shops.rumour: [true] The market cross has started leaning. Old folk say it marks where something's buried, and now it's pointing.

shops.name: Bekkard Emberforge's Smithy
shops.keeper: Bekkard (old) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: You've come about a weapon. Or you're lost. Which?
quirks: Leaves a cup of ale on the anvil each night for the "forge spirit".
Tests every blade on a ham hanging from the ceiling.
shops.rumour: [false] A man ordered a boar spear with a crossbar. Said it wasn't for boar.

shops.name: The Toasty Tankard
shops.keeper: Pandjed (old) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Welcome to the finest hall in town! Also the only hall in town. Ha!
quirks: Taps their claws on the bar in time with the music, whether or not there is any.
Can carry eight full tankards at once and will show off at the slightest excuse.
shops.rumour: [true] A plough horse at Eldercroft cut its furrow in a perfect spiral, then lay down in the middle.

shops.name: Pennywhistle's Sundries & Supplies
shops.keeper: Larkin (middle-aged) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Hello, hello! Don't mind the clutter, it's all for sale. Well, most of it.
quirks: Pays any child who sweeps the porch with a copper and a story.
shops.rumour: [true] The harvest queen goes missing for a day each year and comes back with a basket of fruit nobody can name. It's nearly time.

shops.name: Ingrith & Kin, Bladesmiths
shops.keeper: Ingrith (middle-aged) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: You've come about a weapon. Or you're lost. Which?
quirks: Won't let anyone touch the old hammer on the wall. It belonged to someone important.
shops.rumour: [partly true] Scarecrows on the north farms are being found turned to face the road.

shops.name: The Gentle Gauntlet
shops.keeper: Imma (old) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Oh, that buckle is crying out for help. I can hear it from here.
quirks: Once fitted barding for a carthorse and still sends it a card on its birthday.
Lines every helmet with lambswool, because "heads are precious".
shops.rumour: [false] A chimera tore the door off the toll-house. The guard inside lived thanks to the shield I made him.

shops.name: Mosswick & Mosswick, Apothecaries
shops.keeper: Mabry (middle-aged) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Don't touch the blue one. Or, actually, go ahead, I need the data.
quirks: Tastes every ingredient and describes the flavour like a fussy wine merchant.
Talks to the cauldron in a baby voice "so it won't sulk".
shops.rumour: [false] A physician from Wheatmarket bought my whole stock of smelling salts. He's treating a patient who won't stay awake.

shops.name: The Amber Ember
shops.keeper: Qerrin (ancient) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Quiet, everyone! New guests! ...Right, that's the quiet over. Welcome, friends!
quirks: Feeds peppercorns to a little fire lizard called Kindling that lives in the hearth.
shops.rumour: [true] Market day's been half empty. Everyone from Old Aldridge has stayed home, and nobody there answers letters.

shops.name: Pennywhistle's Sundries & Supplies
shops.keeper: Bramble (old) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Bell's broken, so I'll ring it myself. *ding!* Welcome, welcome!
quirks: Haggles enthusiastically, even when the customer is offering more than the price.
shops.rumour: [true] Nomads sold a scroll they found in a jar under a fallen pillar. Half the town is bidding for it.

shops.name: The Emberforge Grindstone
shops.keeper: Gisla (middle-aged) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Mm. Adventurers. Wipe your boots. Steel hates mud.
quirks: Insists on a firm handshake to seal every sale.
shops.rumour: [true] Someone is poisoning the wells along the trade road, one by one.

shops.name: The Hearty Helm
shops.keeper: Oska (middle-aged) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Oh, you've been walking lopsided. That's the pauldron. Come, let me fix it.
quirks: Talks to the armor stands as if they were old friends.
shops.rumour: [true] A squire had his master's shield repainted. New crest, new colours, and he begged me not to tell anyone the old ones.

shops.name: Pottle Mosswick's Tonics & Tinctures
shops.keeper: Pottle (middle-aged) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Welcome to Mosswick's! If anything starts singing, tell me immediately.
quirks: Hands every customer a feedback card that begins "Any new tails? (Y/N)".
shops.rumour: [false] A trader in Old Lowreach sells a 'giant's strength tonic'. Three customers have grown hair on their palms and nothing else.

shops.name: Vessaline's Emporium of the Arcane
shops.keeper: Vessaline (older) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Welcome back. No, you have not been here before. Not yet.
quirks: Is never seen arriving or leaving. They are simply behind the counter.
shops.rumour: [true] Every candle in my shop guttered at the same moment last night. All of them leaned east.

shops.name: The Golden Flagon
shops.keeper: Seshka (young) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Mind the step, it's older than me! Now, who's hungry? Everyone? Good answer!
quirks: Counts heads at breakfast and frets aloud if any guest is missing.
Hangs a sword over the fireplace that is "purely decorative". It is very sharp.
shops.rumour: [true] Agatha the one-eyed fiddler ploughed up a stone with writing on it. The priest took it away and won't say what it said.

shops.name: The Thirsty Wyrm
shops.keeper: Jhessa (young) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Welcome to the finest hall in town! Also the only hall in town. Ha!
quirks: Keeps a wall of tankards for regulars, and one hook that is always left empty.
shops.rumour: [partly true] Hay carts coming from Cherrymere are being stopped and searched by men who don't wear the lord's colours.

shops.name: The Cluttered Pocket
shops.keeper: Biddy (middle-aged) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Look at the state of those boots! Sit down, I've got just the thing. Probably.
quirks: Gets the hiccups when telling a fib, which is why they're so honest.
shops.rumour: [true] Godric the eel-catcher swears the scales in the market are weighted. They want someone to prove it before the fair.

shops.name: Pennywhistle's Sundries & Supplies
shops.keeper: Wynn (ancient) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Wipe your boots, dears. Now then, what can a Pennywhistle do for you?
quirks: Hums the same tune constantly and does not realise it.
shops.rumour: [true] The chapel bell rang thirteen times at midnight. The bell-rope was cut years ago.

shops.name: The Emberforge Grindstone
shops.keeper: Ketilda (middle-aged) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Emberforge steel. Best this side of the mountains. Best the other side too.
quirks: Lectures on oiling your blade with every sale, then throws in a free rag.
Leaves a cup of ale on the anvil each night for the "forge spirit".
shops.rumour: [partly true] The harvest queen goes missing for a day each year and comes back with a basket of fruit nobody can name. It's nearly time.

shops.name: Thornhide Fitting House
shops.keeper: Drogga (middle-aged) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Every dent tells a story. I'd rather you had fewer stories.
quirks: Has never lost a staring contest, mostly because they forget they are in one.
Saves a button from every coat they have ever mended and can name each owner.
shops.rumour: [false] New orders from the watch: helmets with visors that shut all the way. Whatever's out there, they don't want the men looking at it.

shops.name: Nimsy's Draughts & Doses
shops.keeper: Nimsy (older) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Welcome to Mosswick's! If anything starts singing, tell me immediately.
quirks: Is missing an eyebrow. Do not ask about the eyebrow.
Will trade potions for interesting rocks, beetles or gossip about rival alchemists.
shops.rumour: [true] Someone stole my recipe book. The only page they kept was the one on sleeping sickness.

shops.name: Pottle Mosswick's Tonics & Tinctures
shops.keeper: Pottle (young) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Mind the floor, it had a spill and it's still deciding what it is.
quirks: Keeps two fire buckets by the door, one labelled "CUSTOMERS" and one labelled "ME".
shops.rumour: [false] Willow bark's running short. Every fever in Upper Higham is the same fever, and it isn't breaking.

shops.name: The Moonlit Key
shops.keeper: Maerith (ancient) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: You have a question. Keep it. It is worth more unasked.
quirks: Keeps a locked door at the back that no Veyl will admit to having opened.
Their key earring hums softly whenever someone in the shop tells a lie.
shops.rumour: [true] Every clock in town stopped at the same minute yesterday. Mine started again an hour later. The others haven't.

shops.name: The Amber Goose
shops.keeper: Vexmira (middle-aged) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Cold hands? Hold this mug a moment. *puff* There, mulled. You're welcome!
quirks: Warms each guest's bedsheets with a careful breath before they turn in.
shops.rumour: [true] The Thornhide family's woodpile walked off in the night, logs and kindling, in a trail towards the old hollow.

shops.name: The Roaring Kettle
shops.keeper: Kesh (young) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Mud on the floor? Pah! Mud's good luck in a Hearthscale house. Come in, come in!
quirks: Lets anyone sleep by the hearth for free on stormy nights, no questions asked.
shops.rumour: [true] Drovers coming down from the north hills say their herd counts one more head every morning.

shops.name: The Plump Larder
shops.keeper: Rosamund (ancient) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Come in, dears! Have you eaten? You look like you haven't eaten. Biscuit?
quirks: Wears their sky blue curls pinned up with a pencil and loses the pencil hourly.
Gives directions by gossip: "Left at the house where the miller's wife left him."
shops.rumour: [true] Honey from the wild hives to the north makes folk fall asleep where they stand. The bees seem fine.

shops.name: Lettice Pennywhistle's Emporium
shops.keeper: Lettice (young) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Welcome, welcome! If we haven't got it, my cousin in the next town does.
quirks: Runs a noticeboard of lost pets, odd jobs and strange sightings.
shops.rumour: [true] The market cross has started leaning. Old folk say it marks where something's buried, and now it's pointing.

shops.name: Emberforge Forgeworks
shops.keeper: Eskja (middle-aged) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Give that axe here. ...Who's been chopping firewood with this? Shame on you.
quirks: Bangs the anvil once to close each sale, loud enough to rattle the windows.
shops.rumour: [true] A sellsword bought every crossbow bolt I had and asked the way to the old quarry.

shops.name: Hagga Thornhide's Mail & Plate
shops.keeper: Hagga (middle-aged) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Welcome to Thornhide's. Take your time. Armour should never be rushed, and neither should you.
quirks: Keeps a rag doll in full plate on the counter. The doll's fit is flawless.
shops.rumour: [partly true] Someone in Elmgrove is selling shoddy armour stamped with my family's mark. I'd like a word with them.

shops.name: Doddle Mosswick's Tonics & Tinctures
shops.keeper: Doddle (middle-aged) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Customers! Wonderful! Any allergies? Any extra limbs? No? Pity.
quirks: Will brew anything once, "for science", if the party fetches the ingredients.
Constantly corrects the spelling on their own labels.
shops.rumour: [partly true] Someone is leaving carved wooden dolls on doorsteps. They look like the people inside.

shops.name: The Crescent Door
shops.keeper: Caelum (ancient) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Welcome. Please do not make eye contact with the mirror.
quirks: Sorts the stock by mood rather than type, and the moods change daily.
Hums an old tune that every customer half-remembers from childhood.
shops.rumour: [true] The tower at Thornshaw End has been dark for a month. Its wizard owes me a book.

shops.name: The Smoking Tankard
shops.keeper: Garrun (middle-aged) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Boots off the table, weapons by the door, and tell me everything.
quirks: Ends each night with a toast "to the ones still on the road", and everyone must stand.
Has a framed, scorched menu from "the night of the incident" and won't say more.
shops.rumour: [false] The cows in the south pasture are giving blue milk. Tastes fine, they say. I'm not trying it.

shops.name: The Crooked Hearth
shops.keeper: Torrash (middle-aged) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Cold hands? Hold this mug a moment. *puff* There, mulled. You're welcome!
quirks: Writes to the other Hearthscale inns, so they often know the party is coming.
shops.rumour: [true] A child in Wolfhay draws pictures of things before they happen. Her latest is a bridge on fire.

shops.name: The Thrifty Basket
shops.keeper: Ottilie (old) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Welcome to Pennywhistle's! Rope, lanterns, string and gossip. Mostly gossip.
quirks: Hangs a "Back Soon" sign in the window and has never once taken it down.
shops.rumour: [false] A wealthy stranger is buying up the debts of every shop on the high street. Mine included.

shops.name: The Lucky Larder
shops.keeper: Larkin (young) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Hello, hello! Don't mind the clutter, it's all for sale. Well, most of it.
quirks: Sneaks a boiled sweet into every parcel and denies all knowledge.
Saves string. Every bit of string. There is a ball of it the size of a pony.
shops.rumour: [true] Lettice the thatcher is selling off family heirlooms in a hurry. Debts, or something worse.

shops.name: The Ringing Bellows
shops.keeper: Eskja (middle-aged) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Give that axe here. ...Who's been chopping firewood with this? Shame on you.
quirks: Engraves a motto on any blade for free, but chooses the motto themselves.
shops.rumour: [partly true] A field to the east has a ring of dead wheat in the middle. Perfect circle, and it grows a little every night.

shops.name: The Sharp Bellows
shops.keeper: Hrolf (middle-aged) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: *clang* ...*clang* ...With you in a minute. *clang*
quirks: Lectures on oiling your blade with every sale, then throws in a free rag.
Wears a heavy leather apron older than the shop, patched with steel plates.
shops.rumour: [true] A sellsword sold me her blade for half its worth. Said she won't need it where she's going.

shops.name: Thornhide Armory
shops.keeper: Mabbet (middle-aged) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Every dent tells a story. I'd rather you had fewer stories.
quirks: Cannot abide a squeak and oils every hinge in the room, including yours if you stand still.
shops.rumour: [true] Someone in Plumridge is selling shoddy armour stamped with my family's mark. I'd like a word with them.

shops.name: The Snug Bulwark
shops.keeper: Mott (older) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Come in, come in. Breathe in for me. And out. Hmm. We can work with that.
quirks: Hums lullabies while hammering out dents, and never misses a beat.
shops.rumour: [false] A shepherd swears one ram leads his whole flock up to the old hill fort at night.

shops.name: Pockle's Brews & Blunders
shops.keeper: Pockle (older) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Customers! Wonderful! Any allergies? Any extra limbs? No? Pity.
quirks: Writes recipes in rhyme to make them easier to remember. They are not easier to remember.
shops.rumour: [true] The Hearthscale family keep buying my strongest headache cure. Their whole house hums, they say, a low note day and night.

shops.name: Mosswick Elixirs (Mostly Safe)
shops.keeper: Clatter (young) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Oh good, a volunteer! Sorry, a customer. Same thing, really.
quirks: Believes the toad in the corner is a cursed cousin and serves it tea every afternoon.
shops.rumour: [true] Willow bark's running short. Every fever in Greenvale is the same fever, and it isn't breaking.

shops.name: The Starlit Lantern
shops.keeper: Corynth (middle-aged) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Ah. The bell did not ring, and yet here you are.
quirks: Collects lost things, and may have something a party member lost years ago.
shops.rumour: [false] A book in my back room has been warm to the touch since the new moon. I'd sell it cheap to someone who won't ask.

shops.name: The Seventh Lantern
shops.keeper: Ellisande (middle-aged) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Close the door softly. Some of the stock is sleeping.
quirks: Asks each customer for a single hair "for the records", and never says which records.
shops.rumour: [partly true] The scarecrow on the Emberforge family's plot wears a different hat every morning. Nobody's lending it hats.

shops.name: The Drowsy Hearth
shops.keeper: Farideh (young) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Welcome, friend! You'll want the stew. Everyone wants the stew. *slaps the bar*
quirks: Pours the first drink from every new barrel onto the hearth "for the ancestors".
shops.rumour: [true] A cloaked stranger paid for a room for a week and hasn't once come out of it.

shops.name: The Wandering Ember
shops.keeper: Ghesh (middle-aged) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Ha! Back from the wilds with all your fingers? That calls for a round!
quirks: Hangs a sword over the fireplace that is "purely decorative". It is very sharp.
shops.rumour: [partly true] A knight in mourning black passed through asking the way to Whitewash.

shops.name: Orrin Pennywhistle's Emporium
shops.keeper: Orrin (middle-aged) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Back again? Oh, no, that was the other lot. You all look alike under the mud.
quirks: Is convinced one of the adventurers is secretly royalty.
shops.rumour: [false] Somebody's been paying for flour with coins from a mint that closed before my grandmother was born.

shops.name: Rufus Pennywhistle's General Goods
shops.keeper: Rufus (ancient) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Ooh, adventurers! Are you here about the business at the mill? No? You will be.
quirks: Is feuding (politely) with the baker next door.
Can't resist reading a customer's shopping list aloud to the whole shop.
shops.rumour: [true] The market cross has started leaning. Old folk say it marks where something's buried, and now it's pointing.

shops.name: Oskeld & Kin, Bladesmiths
shops.keeper: Oskeld (ancient) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Shop's open. Forge is hot. Don't just stand there.
quirks: Fixes dented pots for the neighbours for free, grumbling the whole time.
shops.rumour: [partly true] Highwaymen to the north wear painted wooden masks. Folk say they never speak a word.

shops.name: The Grim Bellows
shops.keeper: Ilsa (older) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Mm. Tall ones. Mind your heads. Ceilings are built for proper folk.
quirks: Accepts payment in coin or good ale. Nothing else. Not even gems.
Is dreadfully allergic to cats, and every cat in town knows it.
shops.rumour: [true] A hunter brought in a trophy off a wereboar to be set as a knife handle. Said there were more where that came from.

shops.name: Burla Thornhide, Mailwright
shops.keeper: Burla (ancient) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Ah, adventurers. I can tell by the dents. And the smell. Mostly the dents.
quirks: A sparrow nests in the visor of a display helm, and nobody is allowed to close it.
shops.rumour: [partly true] A werewolf tore the door off the toll-house. The guard inside lived thanks to the shield I made him.

shops.name: The Riveted Gauntlet
shops.keeper: Bodge (young) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: There you are. I had a feeling someone would need me today.
quirks: Hums lullabies while hammering out dents, and never misses a beat.
shops.rumour: [true] Three mercenaries came back from Wrenflats-on-the-River with their mail rusted orange overnight. Rain doesn't do that.

shops.name: The Bubbling Beaker
shops.keeper: Quibble (middle-aged) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Don't mind the hair, it was a different colour this morning. What brings you in?
quirks: Gets distracted mid-sentence by a new idea and scribbles it down.
Talks to the cauldron in a baby voice "so it won't sulk".
shops.rumour: [partly true] Foxglove's gone from every hedge for a mile. Somebody's picking it by night, and foxglove's no toy.

shops.name: Quillon Mosswick's Tonics & Tinctures
shops.keeper: Quillon (ancient) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Come in! Mind the cat. That's not a cat. Mind it anyway.
quirks: Lets customers choose the colour of their potion. It does not affect the potion. Probably.
Keeps a frog familiar that "tastes-tests" ingredients.
shops.rumour: [true] There's a mushroom in the churchyard that wasn't there yesterday. Bright blue, and it smells of cinnamon.

shops.name: Aurevel's Cabinet of Unlikely Things
shops.keeper: Aurevel (older) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Everything here has a price. Not everything has a price in gold.
quirks: Keeps a bowl of unmarked keys and invites each customer to take one. Nobody knows what they open.
Speaks of the other Veyls as if they were all the same person.
shops.rumour: [true] A travelling scholar paid in advance for any book bound with a black ribbon. Any at all.

shops.name: The Locked Lantern
shops.keeper: Selvarin (older) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Welcome to House Veyl. The door will let you leave when it is ready.
quirks: Offers haggling customers a riddle: solve it and the price drops, fail and it rises.
shops.rumour: [true] A harpy has been seen wearing a silver collar. Someone, somewhere, thinks it belongs to them.

shops.name: The Toasty Ember
shops.keeper: Ghesh (ancient) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Rooms upstairs, food at the bar, gossip anywhere you like. What'll it be, friends?
quirks: Counts heads at breakfast and frets aloud if any guest is missing.
Remembers everyone's name except the person they've known the longest.
shops.rumour: [false] A lad comes in every evening asking if his father's back from Brackham. His father left three years ago.

shops.name: The Merry Ox
shops.keeper: Azhani (middle-aged) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Boots off the table, weapons by the door, and tell me everything.
quirks: Has a framed, scorched menu from "the night of the incident" and won't say more.
shops.rumour: [false] The cows in the north pasture are giving blue milk. Tastes fine, they say. I'm not trying it.

shops.name: The Hungry Tankard
shops.keeper: Rhogar (ancient) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Mind the step, it's older than me! Now, who's hungry? Everyone? Good answer!
quirks: Is teaching the inn cat to fetch, and it is going badly.
Taps their claws on the bar in time with the music, whether or not there is any.
shops.rumour: [false] Someone dug up the soldiers' graves on the old battlefield. Only the weapons are gone.

shops.name: Pennywhistle's Everything Shop
shops.keeper: Gertie (old) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Bell's broken, so I'll ring it myself. *ding!* Welcome, welcome!
quirks: Has an ancient, enormous cat that sleeps on the counter.
shops.rumour: [false] Hew the baker ploughed up a stone with writing on it. The priest took it away and won't say what it said.

shops.name: The Bottomless Pocket
shops.keeper: Cobb (young) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Well! Strangers! Where are you from, where are you going, and who's paying?
quirks: Asks the party for their birthdays and writes them down "for later".
shops.rumour: [false] The lord's steward has been measuring fields with a rope and a strange brass gauge. Nobody asked him to.

shops.name: The Patchwork Larder
shops.keeper: Kit (young) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Hello, hello! Don't mind the clutter, it's all for sale. Well, most of it.
quirks: Gives directions by gossip: "Left at the house where the miller's wife left him."
Has a crate of "things adventurers left behind" and wants help returning them.
shops.rumour: [false] The pedlar who comes every spring hasn't turned up. Twenty years, and he's never once been late.

shops.name: The Sooty Anvil
shops.keeper: Halvor (middle-aged) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Ask the price, I'll tell you. Haggle, and I'll double it.
quirks: Won't set jewels in a hilt: "Jewels are for folk who can't fight."
shops.rumour: [true] The new reeve in Applestead is taxing ale by the sip.

shops.name: Durgra's Smithy
shops.keeper: Durgra (young) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Don't touch the edge. Everyone touches the edge.
quirks: Keeps the ashes of their very first forge fire in a little urn on the mantel.
Spots a left-handed customer instantly and rebalances their blade for free.
shops.rumour: [true] The garrison captain ordered fifty spears and won't say what for.

shops.name: Emberforge Arms
shops.keeper: Druvik (old) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Ask the price, I'll tell you. Haggle, and I'll double it.
quirks: Distrusts elven blades on principle, but secretly owns one to study.
shops.rumour: [true] Three swords came in for sharpening, all with the same black stain that won't scour off.

shops.name: The Steadfast Gauntlet
shops.keeper: Vella (young) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Is anybody hurt? Truly? Then let's keep it that way.
quirks: Cannot refuse a child who wants to try on a helmet, so a box of tiny ones sits by the door.
Speaks so softly that customers lean in, then apologises for making them lean.
shops.rumour: [true] The hedges along the west lane grew a foot overnight, and they're thickest on the side facing the manor.

shops.name: Thornhide Mending & Mail
shops.keeper: Brakka (older) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Oh, that buckle is crying out for help. I can hear it from here.
quirks: Worries aloud about the party's sleep, diet and choice of friends.
Grows prize marrows behind the forge and will discuss them at great length.
shops.rumour: [true] Every helmet that comes back from the old fort has scratches on the inside.

shops.name: The Kindly Helm
shops.keeper: Zurra (young) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Welcome to Thornhide's. Take your time. Armour should never be rushed, and neither should you.
quirks: Asks who you are coming home to, and engraves the name inside your breastplate for free.
shops.rumour: [false] A plough horse at Elmchurch-on-the-River cut its furrow in a perfect spiral, then lay down in the middle.

shops.name: The Curious Alembic
shops.keeper: Fliss (young) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Don't touch the blue one. Or, actually, go ahead, I need the data.
quirks: Glows faintly in the dark after a lab accident and uses it to save on candles.
shops.rumour: [true] I'll pay good silver for moonpetal. It only grows near the old barrow, and I'm not going there.

shops.name: Mosswick Remedies
shops.keeper: Mabry (young) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Welcome to Mosswick's! If anything starts singing, tell me immediately.
quirks: Offers free samples on a spoon while holding a bucket nearby, "just in case".
shops.rumour: [false] Hay carts coming from Old Tarnbarrow are being stopped and searched by men who don't wear the lord's colours.

shops.name: The Hiccuping Beaker
shops.keeper: Orryn (young) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Oh good, a volunteer! Sorry, a customer. Same thing, really.
quirks: Labels everything with dates in a calendar nobody else uses.
shops.rumour: [false] A healer came through offering to buy memories. Small ones. Said it was for a tonic.

shops.name: The Veyl Reliquary
shops.keeper: Seraveth (middle-aged) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Ah. You are earlier than I foresaw. Or I am later. Sit.
quirks: Speaks of the other Veyls as if they were all the same person.
shops.rumour: [false] The dead in the old barrow have started keeping time. Listen for the drums.

shops.name: The Hidden Mirror
shops.keeper: Isvaine (young) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Hush. The candles are listening, and they gossip terribly.
quirks: Owns a quill that writes on its own, and it is taking notes on the party.
shops.rumour: [partly true] The harvest came in twice this year. Twice. Nobody is asking how.

shops.name: Saevel's Shelf of Quiet Marvels
shops.keeper: Saevel (older) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Touch nothing that hums. Everything else may be touched, briefly.
quirks: Is exquisitely polite to the furniture.
Keeps a bowl of unmarked keys and invites each customer to take one. Nobody knows what they open.
shops.rumour: [false] Ellen the hermit up the hill has been sleepwalking to the standing stones and drawing circles in the dirt. Perfect circles.

shops.name: The Amber Wyrm
shops.keeper: Arjhan (ancient) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Mind the step, it's older than me! Now, who's hungry? Everyone? Good answer!
quirks: Collects odd coins from far-off lands and will swap a hot meal for a new one.
shops.rumour: [true] There are lanterns in the caves under the cliffs again, but nobody's landed any goods in months.

shops.name: The Amber Goose
shops.keeper: Nimvar (older) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Rooms upstairs, food at the bar, gossip anywhere you like. What'll it be, friends?
quirks: Wears tiny spectacles perched on their snout, purely for reading the tab.
shops.rumour: [true] The Pennywhistle family booked my whole upstairs for a wedding. There's no bride that anyone's met.

shops.name: Hazrith's Hearthside
shops.keeper: Hazrith (young) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: In you come! Grab a stool quick, before the bard spots you and starts a ballad.
quirks: Judges a guest's character by how they eat their porridge, and is rarely wrong.
shops.rumour: [true] Pilgrims bound for the shrine at Upper Ashquay keep turning back halfway. They say the road gets longer the further you walk.

shops.name: Tamsin's Odds & Ends
shops.keeper: Tamsin (older) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Don't tell me, let me guess. Rope, rations and a tinderbox? Thought so!
quirks: Swaps goods for stories, recipes or seeds, but never, ever for an IOU.
Counts change aloud in a sing-song, and starts over if interrupted.
shops.rumour: [true] There's a patch on the green where the grass won't grow, shaped exactly like a door.

shops.name: The Lucky Basket
shops.keeper: Quenby (middle-aged) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Back again? Oh, no, that was the other lot. You all look alike under the mud.
quirks: Has three apprentice nieces and nephews and mixes up all their names.
Sorts the coins in the till by how shiny they are.
shops.rumour: [true] Somebody paid me to stop selling lamp oil to the Hearthscale family. I took the money. I still sell them the oil.

shops.name: Perpetua's Odds & Ends
shops.keeper: Perpetua (middle-aged) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Ooh, adventurers! Are you here about the business at the mill? No? You will be.
quirks: Writes letters to every other Pennywhistle shop weekly and will happily pass messages along.
Talks to the stock, apologising to the tins as they are moved.
shops.rumour: [true] The mill wheel turned all night with the sluice shut. There wasn't a drop in the race.

shops.name: Emberforge Arms
shops.keeper: Brisa (ancient) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Shop's open. Forge is hot. Don't just stand there.
quirks: Grumbles about "young folk these days" and their flimsy rapiers.
shops.rumour: [true] There's a duel set for dawn on the green. Both sides have been in here asking for a second.

shops.name: Dunmar's Smithy
shops.keeper: Dunmar (older) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Don't lean on that. Or that. Just stand in the middle. Good.
quirks: Is dreadfully allergic to cats, and every cat in town knows it.
shops.rumour: [false] Gulls won't land on the east jetty. Not one, not even for bread.

shops.name: Emberforge Blades & Bows
shops.keeper: Haldrek (older) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Emberforge made it, Emberforge stands by it. What d'you need?
quirks: Wears a leather eyepatch over a perfectly good eye, "to rest it for fine work".
shops.rumour: [true] Bandits to the north have a new leader. They've stopped robbing travellers and started robbing tax wagons.

shops.name: Thornhide Mending & Mail
shops.keeper: Nagra (old) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: There you are. I had a feeling someone would need me today.
quirks: Has never lost a staring contest, mostly because they forget they are in one.
Ties back their braid with a rose gold ribbon a grateful customer gave them years ago.
shops.rumour: [true] A knight came in with dents in her breastplate shaped like a hand. A very large hand.

shops.name: Thornhide & Kin, Armorers
shops.keeper: Bodge (ancient) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Arms up, please. Let's see what we're protecting.
quirks: Reads aloud to the forge fire every evening, "to keep it company".
shops.rumour: [false] Somebody fished a breastplate out of the river with a hole punched right through it. From the inside.

shops.name: Thornhide Armory
shops.keeper: Imma (old) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Gently with the door, please, it's had a long week. Now then, who needs fitting?
quirks: Has snapped three counters by leaning on them and now leans on an anvil instead.
shops.rumour: [true] New orders from the watch: helmets with visors that shut all the way. Whatever's out there, they don't want the men looking at it.

shops.name: Pimm's Draughts & Doses
shops.keeper: Pimm (middle-aged) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Hello hello hello! Sit anywhere except the chair. The chair is new.
quirks: Is mid-feud with a Mosswick cousin over who really invented the hiccup cure.
Hiccups little bubbles whenever they get nervous.
shops.rumour: [partly true] Children in Kelpbrook keep dozing off in the middle of the day, smiling. You can't wake them for an hour.

shops.name: The Wobbly Beaker
shops.keeper: Tilda (ancient) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Welcome to Mosswick's! If anything starts singing, tell me immediately.
quirks: Sends letters to the other Mosswicks comparing notes on customers.
Has worn oven gloves on their feet ever since "the boot incident".
shops.rumour: [true] The midwife's run out of feverfew. If someone would gather it from the old abbey garden, I'd pay well.

shops.name: Pipsy's Curious Concoctions
shops.keeper: Pipsy (middle-aged) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Hold this. No, with both hands. And don't breathe on it.
quirks: Decides one party member has rare blood and keeps politely asking for "just a thimble".
Has not worn a matching pair of socks in years, on principle.
shops.rumour: [true] A traveller left a bottle for me to identify. Whatever's in it, the cork keeps pushing itself out.

shops.name: Myrrin's Emporium of the Arcane
shops.keeper: Myrrin (young) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Welcome to House Veyl. The door will let you leave when it is ready.
quirks: Never gives change, only a small odd trinket of exactly equal value.
shops.rumour: [partly true] Something big has been bumping the hulls in the harbour at night.

shops.name: The Veiled Door
shops.keeper: Yvrenne (middle-aged) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Welcome to House Veyl. The door will let you leave when it is ready.
quirks: Drinks tea that never cools, from a cup that never empties.
shops.rumour: [true] Hodge the goose-herd brought me a letter from the old wizard on the hill. It's dated next spring.

shops.name: The Veyl Reliquary
shops.keeper: Aurevel (middle-aged) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: You were expected. Well... someone was.
quirks: Keeps a small hourglass on the counter in which the sand runs upwards.
shops.rumour: [true] The harbourmaster has been taking bribes to let a certain ship dock after dark.

shops.name: The Roaring Ox
shops.keeper: Ashkarr (young) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Cold hands? Hold this mug a moment. *puff* There, mulled. You're welcome!
quirks: Gets misty-eyed about "the old country" but can never quite say where it was.
shops.rumour: [true] Every sheep at Longleigh was shorn overnight. The wool's gone, and so is whoever sheared them.

shops.name: Ophira's Rest
shops.keeper: Ophira (young) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: You've got a story on you, I can tell. Sit down, have a pie, and spill it.
quirks: Hums old dragon lullabies while sweeping, and the regulars nod off in their chairs.
shops.rumour: [false] Avice the potter swears they saw my old cat at the north crossroads. The cat died last spring.

shops.name: Vexmira's Rest
shops.keeper: Vexmira (middle-aged) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Mud on the floor? Pah! Mud's good luck in a Hearthscale house. Come in, come in!
quirks: Hangs a sword over the fireplace that is "purely decorative". It is very sharp.
shops.rumour: [true] The tower at Kirkcross has been dark for a month. Its wizard owes me a book.

shops.name: The Snoring Ox
shops.keeper: Drevik (middle-aged) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Make room, everyone, we've got heroes! At least, they look like heroes. Close enough!
quirks: Snores so loudly that upstairs guests are handed cotton for their ears at check-in.
Cannot whisper. Every secret told to them is overheard by the whole common room.
shops.rumour: [true] The Pennywhistle family threw a feast here and paid with a bag of pearls. Where does a shopkeeper get pearls?

shops.name: Bunty Pennywhistle's Emporium
shops.keeper: Bunty (young) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Welcome, welcome! If we haven't got it, my cousin in the next town does.
quirks: Hums the same tune constantly and does not realise it.
shops.rumour: [partly true] A field to the south has a ring of dead wheat in the middle. Perfect circle, and it grows a little every night.

shops.name: Pennywhistle's Sundries & Supplies
shops.keeper: Perpetua (middle-aged) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Welcome to Pennywhistle's! Rope, lanterns, string and gossip. Mostly gossip.
quirks: Has a pocket for everything and takes ages finding the right one.
shops.rumour: [partly true] The new family at the end of the lane buy food for ten. There are only three of them.

shops.name: The Cosy Counter
shops.keeper: Marigold (middle-aged) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Wipe your boots, dears. Now then, what can a Pennywhistle do for you?
quirks: Weighs everything on brass scales they claim have never told a lie.
shops.rumour: [partly true] Beatrix the beadle ploughed up a stone with writing on it. The priest took it away and won't say what it said.

shops.name: Pennywhistle's Everything Shop
shops.keeper: Tuck (ancient) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Bell's broken, so I'll ring it myself. *ding!* Welcome, welcome!
quirks: Hangs a "Back Soon" sign in the window and has never once taken it down.
shops.rumour: [false] Perkin the rat-catcher hasn't paid their tab in three months, and nobody knows where their money went.

shops.name: Emberforge Arms
shops.keeper: Eskja (young) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Mm. Adventurers. Wipe your boots. Steel hates mud.
quirks: Is dreadfully allergic to cats, and every cat in town knows it.
Fixes dented pots for the neighbours for free, grumbling the whole time.
shops.rumour: [partly true] Three swords came in for sharpening, all with the same black stain that won't scour off.

shops.name: Kolbrand Emberforge, Weaponsmith
shops.keeper: Kolbrand (middle-aged) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Hmph. Show me your hands. ...Calluses. Good. Come in.
quirks: Makes customers name their new weapon before they can leave with it.
shops.rumour: [false] Will the swineherd ordered a heavy crossbow and a hundred bolts. Says it's for rats.

shops.name: Dagna's Forge
shops.keeper: Dagna (older) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Mm. Adventurers. Wipe your boots. Steel hates mud.
quirks: Jots each customer's measurements on a slate, in case they come back.
shops.rumour: [true] Raiders hit a farmstead to the north and left a spear in the door with a ribbon tied round it.

shops.name: Emberforge Blades & Bows
shops.keeper: Haldrek (old) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Don't touch the edge. Everyone touches the edge.
quirks: Won't name a price until the customer has held the weapon for a full minute.
shops.rumour: [true] Bring me a piece of a giant boar and I'll make arrowheads that bite through anything.

shops.name: Wurma's Fittings
shops.keeper: Wurma (old) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: There you are. I had a feeling someone would need me today.
quirks: Has never lost a staring contest, mostly because they forget they are in one.
shops.rumour: [true] The scarecrow on the Pennywhistle family's plot wears a different hat every morning. Nobody's lending it hats.

shops.name: Narrek's Fittings
shops.keeper: Narrek (middle-aged) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: There you are. I had a feeling someone would need me today.
quirks: Hands each customer a care guide for their armour, illustrated with little drawings.
shops.rumour: [partly true] The lord's steward has been measuring fields with a rope and a strange brass gauge. Nobody asked him to.

shops.name: Orvik Thornhide's Mail & Plate
shops.keeper: Orvik (middle-aged) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Hello, hello. Stand on the little box, please, so I don't have to kneel.
quirks: Knits chainmail-patterned scarves in their spare time.
Asks who you are coming home to, and engraves the name inside your breastplate for free.
shops.rumour: [false] Sybil the cooper ordered child-sized armor. Twelve sets. Paid in advance.

shops.name: The Dented Helm
shops.keeper: Durn (ancient) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Oh dear, who fitted that for you? Come here, come here.
quirks: Weighs each customer "for the fitting", then asks very gently if they are eating enough.
shops.rumour: [partly true] A company of sellswords has camped to the west with no banner. They paid me in foreign silver.

shops.name: Tibbet's Brews & Blunders
shops.keeper: Tibbet (older) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Don't touch the blue one. Or, actually, go ahead, I need the data.
quirks: Wears a necklace of tiny vials and sips one whenever the conversation gets dull.
shops.rumour: [true] Someone is buying up the old orchards and felling every tree but one in each.

shops.name: Mosswick Remedies
shops.keeper: Clatter (middle-aged) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Come in! Mind the cat. That's not a cat. Mind it anyway.
quirks: Offers a discount if you try an experimental potion. Results vary.
shops.rumour: [partly true] Scarecrows on the north farms are being found turned to face the road.

shops.name: Mosswick & Mosswick, Apothecaries
shops.keeper: Nock (middle-aged) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Don't mind the hair, it was a different colour this morning. What brings you in?
quirks: Cranks a big fan that blows the fumes out of the window and into the neighbour's shop.
shops.rumour: [true] Someone ordered enough sleeping draught to fell a giant. Paid in very old coins.

shops.name: The Frothing Cauldron
shops.keeper: Pockle (middle-aged) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Don't mind the hair, it was a different colour this morning. What brings you in?
quirks: Charges by the gulp, and watches very closely.
Keeps two fire buckets by the door, one labelled "CUSTOMERS" and one labelled "ME".
shops.rumour: [true] The new reeve in Cressleigh-on-the-River is taxing ale by the sip.

shops.name: House Veyl, Purveyors of Portents
shops.keeper: Myrael (middle-aged) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Mm. You smell of rain from a town you have not visited yet.
quirks: Their shadow moves a moment after they do.
shops.rumour: [partly true] An apprentice came in asking how to unsummon something. Very politely. Very pale.

shops.name: Eredan's Cabinet of Unlikely Things
shops.keeper: Eredan (ancient) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Ah. The bell did not ring, and yet here you are.
quirks: Owns a quill that writes on its own, and it is taking notes on the party.
Presses flowers from long-forgotten battlefields and knows the story of each.
shops.rumour: [false] A moth the size of my hand circles my shop sign every night and always lands on the same letter.

shops.name: The Veyl Reliquary
shops.keeper: Cyrandel (middle-aged) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Close the door softly. Some of the stock is sleeping.
quirks: Asks each customer for a single hair "for the records", and never says which records.
Has a single midnight blue streak in their hair that shifts shade when the weather turns.
shops.rumour: [false] The harvest came in twice this year. Twice. Nobody is asking how.

shops.name: Veyl Antiquities
shops.keeper: Oressa (young) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Close the door softly. Some of the stock is sleeping.
quirks: Lights candles with a whisper rather than a flame.
Finishes customers' sentences, sometimes before they have started them.
shops.rumour: [true] Scrolls bought at the last fair are going blank in folks' hands. Someone's selling faded magic.

shops.name: The Hungry Tankard
shops.keeper: Torinn (middle-aged) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Boots off the table, weapons by the door, and tell me everything.
quirks: Hums old dragon lullabies while sweeping, and the regulars nod off in their chairs.
Brews a secret family ale and will only say it contains "a bit of dragon".
shops.rumour: [true] The coach from Little Briartor arrived with no driver. The horses knew the way.

shops.name: The Snoring Ox
shops.keeper: Gorvesh (young) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Cold hands? Hold this mug a moment. *puff* There, mulled. You're welcome!
quirks: Polishes the same tankard all day and gets twitchy if anyone else touches the cloth.
shops.rumour: [false] Dunstan the woodward has had hiccups for nine days. Nothing I give works. Started after they drank from the north spring.

shops.name: The Hearthscale Arms
shops.keeper: Kethra (older) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Ah, adventurers! I can smell the road on you. Baths are extra, and worth every copper.
quirks: Gives every regular a nickname, and will have one for each of the party by closing time.
Wears tiny spectacles perched on their snout, purely for reading the tab.
shops.rumour: [false] A blade came in for repair with a hilt shaped like a coiled serpent. Its owner never came back for it.

shops.name: The Snoring Tankard
shops.keeper: Ghesh (young) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Boots off the table, weapons by the door, and tell me everything.
quirks: Hires out the back room for private meetings, then listens at the door with a cup.
shops.rumour: [partly true] Rockslides keep blocking the same stretch of road, always at night, always just after the ore wagons pass.

shops.name: Bramble Pennywhistle's Emporium
shops.keeper: Bramble (young) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Come in before the rain does! Shopping or chatting? Both? Lovely.
quirks: Is certain the shop is haunted by a very tidy ghost who folds the linens.
shops.rumour: [true] A traveller paid me to keep a parcel behind the counter until someone says the word 'lantern'. It's heavy for its size.

shops.name: Pennywhistle's Everything Shop
shops.keeper: Huckle (young) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Welcome, welcome! If we haven't got it, my cousin in the next town does.
quirks: Is convinced one of the adventurers is secretly royalty.
shops.rumour: [true] Our bridge to the south washed out, and someone rebuilt it in a single night. Better than before.

shops.name: Pennywhistle's Provisions
shops.keeper: Elsbeth (young) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Don't tell me, let me guess. Rope, rations and a tinderbox? Thought so!
quirks: Tucks a sprig of lavender behind each customer's ear, whether they like it or not.
shops.rumour: [true] Somebody's been paying for flour with coins from a mint that closed before my grandmother was born.

shops.name: Osgood Pennywhistle's General Goods
shops.keeper: Osgood (old) Drives a hard bargain (+10%)
shops.greeting: Well! Strangers! Where are you from, where are you going, and who's paying?
quirks: Swears the doorbell rings a different note when a stranger walks in.
shops.rumour: [true] Goats from Old Slatepike came down the mountain with gold dust caught in their coats.

shops.name: Emberforge Blades & Bows
shops.keeper: Torvi (young) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Hold it like you mean it, or don't hold it at all.
quirks: Will sharpen your current weapon for free if you tell a good battle story.
Hums so low while working that customers feel it in their teeth.
shops.rumour: [false] The lord has banned blades longer than a hand at market. People say it's because of what happened at the last fair.

shops.name: The Red Hammer
shops.keeper: Barra (young) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Hmph. Show me your hands. ...Calluses. Good. Come in.
quirks: Can tell what metal anything is made of by tapping it with a fingernail.
shops.rumour: [true] The garrison captain ordered fifty spears and won't say what for.

shops.name: Stigrun's Forge
shops.keeper: Stigrun (middle-aged) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: You've come about a weapon. Or you're lost. Which?
quirks: Checks the balance of every weapon on one finger before handing it over.
shops.rumour: [true] Petronel the gravedigger heard hammering behind solid rock in the deep shaft. Next morning every pick in the camp was gone.

shops.name: Emberforge Arms
shops.keeper: Gisla (middle-aged) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Shop's open. Forge is hot. Don't just stand there.
quirks: Bangs the anvil once to close each sale, loud enough to rattle the windows.
shops.rumour: [partly true] A hunter brought in a trophy off an owlbear to be set as a knife handle. Said there were more where that came from.

shops.name: The Patient Bulwark
shops.keeper: Yorna (old) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Good morning. Or afternoon. I lose track when I'm riveting. What needs mending?
quirks: Their tiny spectacles are always fogged from the forge, so they squint at everyone fondly.
shops.rumour: [true] The miners broke into a hall that isn't on any map. They've sealed it up again.

shops.name: Thornhide Mending & Mail
shops.keeper: Agga (ancient) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Oh, that buckle is crying out for help. I can hear it from here.
quirks: Sews a tiny pocket inside every gambeson, "for a lucky charm, or a sweet".
Tests shields by having customers hit them as hard as they can. Is never impressed.
shops.rumour: [partly true] The lord wants every guard in a padded jack by winter. Says arrows are coming. From where?

shops.name: The Patient Shield
shops.keeper: Grobb (young) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Oh, you've been walking lopsided. That's the pauldron. Come, let me fix it.
quirks: Offers a free repair if you bring back a dented piece with a good story.
shops.rumour: [true] Will the tinker ordered child-sized armor. Twelve sets. Paid in advance.

shops.name: The Hearty Helm
shops.keeper: Rokka (middle-aged) Soft-hearted (−5% for a sad story)
shops.greeting: Welcome, little one. ...Yes, you're all little ones to me.
quirks: Practises calligraphy on leather offcuts and gives them away as bookmarks.
Cries at weddings, funerals and particularly well-made rivets.
shops.rumour: [true] Someone in Upper Eaglecroft is selling shoddy armour stamped with my family's mark. I'd like a word with them.

shops.name: Mosswick Remedies
shops.keeper: Tumble (middle-aged) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Welcome! Ignore the smoke, that's normal. Mostly normal.
quirks: Smells strongly of something different every day: lemons, wet dog, thunder.
shops.rumour: [true] The river's tasting of iron. Folk downstream are sickening, and upstream is where the new diggings opened.

shops.name: Mosswick Elixirs (Mostly Safe)
shops.keeper: Mabry (young) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Come in! Mind the cat. That's not a cat. Mind it anyway.
quirks: Tells long stories about cousins who exploded, but swears every one of them is fine now.
Measures ingredients in pinches, smidges and "oh, that's too much".
shops.rumour: [false] The Pennywhistle family's youngest has a rash shaped like a key. Third child this month with the same mark.

shops.name: The Hiccuping Flask
shops.keeper: Zibb (older) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Oh good, a volunteer! Sorry, a customer. Same thing, really.
quirks: Keeps a frog familiar that "tastes-tests" ingredients.
shops.rumour: [false] A woman in a grey hood bought all my mandrake root and asked if I knew where to find more.

shops.name: The Curious Flask
shops.keeper: Wizzle (middle-aged) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Quick question before you buy anything: how do you feel about feathers?
quirks: Uses a brass ear trumpet to listen to potions "settling".
shops.rumour: [true] Robin the brewer brought me a sick crow that talked in its fever. It kept saying one name, over and over: Eaglestow.

shops.name: The Eldest Key
shops.keeper: Lunavel (ancient) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Welcome back. No, you have not been here before. Not yet.
quirks: Wraps every item in black silk and a sprig of rosemary.
shops.rumour: [false] Somebody buried a box of wands under the crossroads. I found two. There were slots for six.

shops.name: The Last Mirror
shops.keeper: Peryndel (ancient) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Welcome back. No, you have not been here before. Not yet.
quirks: Writes price tags in a script that only the right buyer can read.
shops.rumour: [false] A miner came up holding a gem he says was handed to him in the dark, by a hand smaller than a child's.

shops.name: The Veyl Reliquary
shops.keeper: Ashvael (young) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Ah. The bell did not ring, and yet here you are.
quirks: Refers to the moon by a pet name.
shops.rumour: [false] The mine owner's hired a dowser from Old Thornworth. She walks the tunnels with a hazel rod and won't say what she's after.

shops.name: Thorivel's Shelf of Quiet Marvels
shops.keeper: Thorivel (middle-aged) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Do come in. You already have, of course, but it is polite to say so.
quirks: Sorts the stock by mood rather than type, and the moods change daily.
Answers every question with another question, except about prices, which are oddly precise.
shops.rumour: [true] The old wizard's apprentice in Granitewell has been selling off the tower's contents by the crate. I doubt the wizard knows.

shops.name: Tilly's Odds & Ends
shops.keeper: Tilly (young) Gives regulars a discount (−10% on return visits)
shops.greeting: Ooh, new faces! You look like folk who need rope. Everyone needs rope.
quirks: Presses flowers from every traveller's homeland and would love one from the party.
shops.rumour: [false] Honey from the wild hives to the west makes folk fall asleep where they stand. The bees seem fine.

shops.name: Belvarr's Hearthside
shops.keeper: Belvarr (young) Loves to haggle (DC 12 Persuasion for 10% off)
shops.greeting: Welcome, friend! You'll want the stew. Everyone wants the stew. *slaps the bar*
quirks: Ties a gold ribbon round their tail tip and asks every guest to guess what it's for.
Lets anyone sleep by the hearth for free on stormy nights, no questions asked.
shops.rumour: [true] A tax assessor stayed three nights and left without assessing a thing. He took plenty of notes about the chapel, though.

shops.name: Pennywhistle's Everything Shop
shops.keeper: Perpetua (middle-aged) Slightly desperate for sales (−10%)
shops.greeting: Welcome, welcome! If we haven't got it, my cousin in the next town does.
quirks: Writes letters to every other Pennywhistle shop weekly and will happily pass messages along.
Has a pocket for everything and takes ages finding the right one.
shops.rumour: [false] A rich trader from Old Flintshaft wants the old schoolhouse. Offered three times what it's worth, no haggling.

shops.name: Morrin Emberforge's Smithy
shops.keeper: Morrin (old) Fair and firm (no haggling)
shops.greeting: Hrm. You're letting the heat out. In or out.
quirks: Wears a heavy leather apron older than the shop, patched with steel plates.
shops.rumour: [true] The Thornhide folk say the shipments from Coppertor have stopped coming.
